questions.corrige_markdown:
The transpose is obtained by interchanging rows and columns:

$M^{T}=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & x-1\\ 2 & x\end{pmatrix}$.

Two matrices are equal when corresponding entries are equal:

$\begin{pmatrix} 1 & 2\\ x-1 & x\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix} 1 & x-1\\ 2 & x\end{pmatrix}$.

Entry (1,2): $2 = x-1$, so $x = 3$. Entry (2,1): $x-1 = 2$, giving the same value. The other entries ($1=1$ and $x=x$) hold for every $x$.

**$x = 3$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Using this value of $x$, find $M^{2}$. *[6 marks for the whole question]*
